facts.business: GTV Engineering Limited is engaged in hi-tech steel fabrication for EPC contractors across sectors such as Power, Railways, Cement, Minerals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, and other infrastructural projects.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets, including capital advances

Limited geographical reach due to central India location
Increased competition from local and big players in hi-tech specialized fabrication
Change in government policy affecting subsidy payments in infrastructure sectors
